title: Store the state of a call
description: You can inspect the records used to track a function and one invocation of its chunk.

steps.description: Instruction stores an operation and operand. Chunk collects instructions and supports later operand patches.
CallFrame stores a chunk, instruction pointer, and local dictionary. read fetches one instruction and increments the pointer, or returns None at the end.
Function groups a name, parameter names, and chunk. Its representation includes its parameter count.

steps.question: What instruction position does a newly created frame have?

steps.description: The smoke test creates an empty chunk and frame. The displayed position is 0, before any read call.
